opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who will coordinate the visit; some specialist arts institutions are permitted to apply.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research within the UK.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except disease/illness studies and clinical/medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or other institutions of higher education; eligible UK-based independent research institutes/organisations on a trial basis.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Two-stage process; the outline stage is currently paused (will be accepted in the new grants system in autumn 2026), while Detailed Applications are accepted until 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except medical/clinical research, policy-driven, commercial, database-assembly, advocacy, capacity building

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £130,000; Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one and 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by time of taking up the Fellowship; approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, held at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except disease/illness studies and clinical/medical applications

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement teaching costs; research expenses up to an annual maximum of £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers; previous holders of a Major Research Fellowship not eligible.
opportunities.summary: For well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, funding replacement salary costs for two or three years.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration; resident in the UK; permanent member of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing original research. Application materials will be available on the page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: Any discipline except disease/illness studies and clinical/medical applications

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post (up to 0.5 FTE), live in the UK for at least 26 weeks of the year, and hold/have held a post at a UK university or eligible UKRI-funded organisation.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Application materials will be available during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except disease/illness studies and clinical/medical applications

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars with at least two years full-time post-PhD experience in a research/teaching post, holding a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent; one bid per institution.
opportunities.summary: For talented early career scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: Any research area except medical/clinical, policy-driven, commercial, advocacy, database-assembly

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; each university may submit one application as principal applicant; collaborations encouraged.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.
discipline_tags: Any topic in the Trust's remit
